name: linux-studex-register
description: StudEx Group asset register. The Obsidian vault at register/vault/ is the source of truth; WORKSPACE-INDEX.md and index.html are generated.

scripts.sync: node scripts/vault-to-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-vault.mjs && node scripts/build-index.mjs
scripts.check:sync: npm run sync && git diff --exit-code --stat -- assets.json WORKSPACE-INDEX.md index.html vault
